content.what_it_is: MATLAB plotting script that loads an inlet-shoal depth file only to derive a zero-origin 2 m plotting grid (L1-L10), defines sponge/wavemaker overlays (L12-L15), pairs output indices 5 and 7 with text labels 200 and 300 seconds (L18-L19), configures an 8-by-5 inch figure (L21-L24), then for each output loads eta and mask, replaces mask==0 cells with NaN, and draws a two-panel annotated surface-elevation plot (L27-L60). Its sole print command is commented at L61, so it produces no file as written.

params_defined.name: nfile
params_defined.range: must have one time label per entry

params_defined.name: min
params_defined.range: must have one entry per nfile value

equations.ref: one horizontal panel per selected output

unresolved: Parallel-list interface is unchecked: nfile drives the loop at L18/L27 while labels are indexed from the independently defined min cell array at L19/L40. Any length or ordering change to one list yields an indexing failure or silently wrong time label; no time is derived from the output itself.

The variable name min at L19 shadows MATLAB's built-in min for the remainder of the workspace, creating a latent call-interface failure if this script is extended or run interactively without clearing again.

Dimension/orientation assumption: x/y lengths come from dep_shoal_inlet.txt at L4-L10, but the plotted eta and mask are loaded from another directory at L30-L31. There is no check that eta, mask, and dep share shape or orientation before mask indexing at L33 and pcolor at L37. The preceding generator writes the bathymetry with outer i rows and inner j columns, making the x/y interpretation especially suspect.
The only image output is commented at L61, so the figure configured and rendered at L21-L60 is not persisted despite the apparent postprocessing workflow.
Hard-coded user directory at L2 and overlay/label positions through x=300 and y=1200 at L12-L15/L44-L48 are not validated against the loaded domain.
